other.title: Apple Fitness+: Künftig auch im Gym
other.description: Mit „Gym Strength“ hilft Apples Sportdienst dabei, mit Gewichten und Geräten zu trainieren. Dazu gibt es Kurse und eine Erfassung per App.

other.title: Google Photos now lets you stop Memories from ruining the mood
other.description: You can finally stop the app from adding random music to your memories.

other.title: Google: Internetsuche gibt es für Schulen nur, wenn KI-Tools freigegeben sind
other.description: Parallel zur Vorstellung neuer KI-Werkzeuge für Schulen hat Google klargestellt, dass Schulen, die sie sperren, auch die Internetsuche nicht nutzen können.

other.title: Google Messages’ pinned chats UI makeover is finally landing for users
other.description: The pinned chats glow-up is now in beta.

other.title: Follow today’s midterm election results with the Apple News Live Activity
other.description: With votes now being counted in the US midterm elections, the Apple News app offers a convenient way to follow the results in real time. Here’s how it works. more…

robotics.title: ITjuzi: Chinese embodied AI companies raised ~$13B across 322 deals in H1 2026, up 5x YoY, as robot makers shift focus from hardware to AI (Reuters)
robotics.description: Reuters: ITjuzi: Chinese embodied AI companies raised ~$13B across 322 deals in H1 2026, up 5x YoY, as robot makers shift focus from hardware to AI — After years of building humanoid robots capable of running, dancing and performing backflips, Chinese companies are pouring resources into a different challenge …

robotics.title: China Robot Funding Slows to $1.6 Billion as Shakeout Fears Grow
robotics.description: Chinese robotics sector fundraising decelerated sharply in past months to about 11 billion yuan ($1.6 billion) in October, suggesting a cooling in the frenzied pace of investment since Unitree wowed the world with its Spring Festival humanoids showcase.

crypto.title: Jack Dorsey's Block faces $764 million DOJ settlement as bitcoin profit plunges 50%
crypto.description: The proposed agreement would resolve a federal anti-money-laundering investigation, while lower Cash App trading fees halved Block's quarterly bitcoin gross profit.
